name: reveal4-animation
title: Reveal 4 Animation
description: The tightest noise of the set — base frequency 0.5 — so the edge dissolves into fine grain instead of large tears. The two words start centred on a full screen, then FLIP into the layout below as the mask opens under them — one scrubbed timeline drives the title move, the mask and the image together. One of seven on-scroll SVG filter reveals from Codrops' OnScrollFilter (MIT, Codrops), split into a component per reveal.
